external_as_published: Route A 1.34 gCO2e/MJ (4.20 at transmission pipeline outlet less 2.86 at plant exit) = 0.0735; Route B 8.3 MtCO2e over ~170 bcm = 1.356 gCO2e/MJ = 0.0744
